title: Analista de Beneficios Pleno
description:

Local de trabalho: Presencial – bairros na Baixada Fluminense (Nova Iguaçu, Belford Roxo) e Zona Norte do Rio (Méier, Campinho)


⏰ Horário: 08h30 às 17h, com 1h de almoço

Início desejado: 15/12/2025

Contrato temporário: 180 dias, com possibilidade de prorrogação até 270 dias

Estamos buscando um Analista de Operações de Benefícios Pleno com forte experiência em faturamento para atuar no suporte às rotinas operacionais de benefícios (Saúde, Vida e Odonto), garantindo acuracidade, agilidade e organização nas demandas da área.

  • Organizar e executar rotinas operacionais com foco em faturamento de benefícios .

  • Ensino Superior completo ou cursando.
  • Experiência com faturamento de operadoras/clientes (baixar, converter e conferir arquivos).

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Associate (HubSpot/Apollo Preferred)
description:
(Only resumes in English will be considered)


Location:  Remote (must be able to work Eastern Time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET)

Compensation:  Competitive salary with growth opportunities

Start Date:  ASAP


About the Role

We’re one of the fastest-growing proptech companies in the U.S., backed by top-tier VCs and some of the largest landlords and managers in the country.


We’re hiring a Executive Assistant & Operations Associate to keep our revenue engine organized, precise, and moving fast. This role sits at the intersection of sales operations, CRM management, and overall support helping the team run smoother, prep smarter, and close faster.


You’ll support our Sales Directors with everything from HubSpot updates and inbox cleanup to property research, demo prep, and post-event follow-ups. You’ll be the behind-the-scenes force that keeps deals and relationships flowing.


The ideal candidate is a HubSpot pro, an organization master, and someone who loves systems, structure, and clean dashboards. Canva or basic design skills are a big plus.


What You’ll Do

Sales Operations & CRM

  • Maintain CRM hygiene across all deals and pipelines in HubSpot
  • Create follow-ups and tasks from meeting notes to keep deals moving
  • Prepare weekly pipeline reports and monthly sales performance summaries (conversion rates, expansion vs. new logos, etc.)
  • Support with contract preparation, sending, and organization
  • Create and maintain accurate customer accounts within the Cosign portal.

Demo & Meeting Prep

  • Research prospects and properties for personalized sales conversations
  • Build decks and slides for demos
  • Assist with pre- and post-event follow-ups and outreach

Inbox, Calendar & Scheduling

  • Clean up and manage up to 4 sales inboxes weekly
  • Schedule meetings and maintain a sales calendar for QBRs, Expansion, first applicant, property engagement, etc

Sales Enablement & Marketing

  • Update and maintain sales collateral, FAQs, and shared materials
  • Create light Canva designs for decks or visuals
  • Support LinkedIn content coordination and posting
  • Track property-level engagement and follow-ups

Account & Partner Support

  • Conduct strategic account research for new opportunities
  • Track deal follow-ups and ensure nothing slips through the cracks

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of experience in sales operations, CRM management, or executive support
  • HubSpot and/or Apollo expert — comfortable managing pipelines, reports, and automations
  • Ultra-organized with strong attention to detail
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Skilled in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and Canva
  • Proactive, reliable, and fast — you take ownership and anticipate needs
  • Fast learner with a strong interest in using AI tools to optimize and streamline workflows.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a startup or high-growth environment

Need to Have

  • Experience in fast pace high-demanding sales environment
  • Experience at startups, proptech, real estate, or B2B SaaS
  • Strong background in sales/operational support
  • Familiarity with project management tools


What Success Looks Like

  • The Sales teams run with clarity, speed, and zero chaos
  • HubSpot data is accurate, up to date, and ready for action
  • Every demo, event, and partner follow-up feels personal and buttoned up
  • Reports and insights are delivered proactively each week
  • You’re the go-to operator who makes everything — and everyone — run smoother

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Position Summary:


Our partner, a growing streaming and marketing optimization product company, is looking to add a BI Analyst to its team. In this role, your focus will be on analyzing operational business data and transforming it into meaningful insights and actionable strategies. You will collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, extract and analyze data from various platforms, and create actionable reports. You will play a key role in providing valuable insights and supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization. Therefore, the ideal candidate should have a strong analytical mindset, excellent data manipulation skills, and a passion for transforming data into actionable business intelligence.

  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related technical field/experience.
  • 3+ years of experience as a BI Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Experienced in SQL and advanced SQL queries, to extract and manipulate data.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and how to design effective data structures for reporting and analysis.

  • SQL Queries
  • MySQL
  • SQL Server
  • PostgreSQL
  • Power BI
  • Tableau
  • BI Analysis
  • Data Visualization & Reporting (Google Looker Preferred)
  • Business Presentations
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication
  • Python (a plus)


Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Collect and extract data from SQL databases using advanced queries and data modeling.
  • Utilize data analysis techniques to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights from complex datasets.
  • Develop reports to provide valuable insights to stakeholders that will support data-driven decision-making.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand and identify business needs and document reporting requirements.
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools to anticipate future trends and outcomes, helping in strategic planning.
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting by validating data integrity.
  • Maintain documentation of reports, queries, and data processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data-related processes, data quality, and reporting efficiency, resolving data discrepancies or inconsistencies.
  • Stay updated with the latest BI trends, tools, and technologies, incorporating best practices into work, to improve reporting capabilities.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.


Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: Analista de Cobrança TM Digital
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir os processos de análise de crédito, por meio da verificação documental e avaliação criteriosa das informações, emitindo parecer técnico com aprovação, reprovação ou encaminhamento para instâncias superiores, conforme alçada estabelecida.
  • Fornecer informações completas e estruturadas à equipe comercial, filiais e instâncias superiores, assegurando embasamento sólido para decisões de crédito e cobrança assertivas.
  • Participar ativamente das negociações com clientes e time comercial, respeitando as diretrizes da política da companhia em termos de prazos, juros e condições, além de propor estruturas diferenciadas e personalizadas visando resolver conflitos e aumentar a rentabilidade das operações.
  • Executar o acompanhamento físico e remoto das garantias vinculadas às operações de crédito, reportando avanços e desvios ao Supervisor Regional conforme os parâmetros definidos.
  • Manter agenda contínua de visitas técnicas aos clientes para fortalecer o relacionamento, monitorar a evolução dos negócios e avaliar riscos locais, com produção de relatórios específicos sobre clientes e contexto da filial.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento e cobrança de clientes inadimplentes, conforme a régua definida pela Política de Crédito, além de manter relacionamento com tradings e armazéns terceiros responsáveis por produtos em garantia ou renegociados.
  • Consolidar e reportar ao Supervisor Regional os KPIs da filial conforme o cronograma definido pelo Gerente de Crédito, contribuindo para a gestão estratégica da área.
  • Realizar análise documental (CPRs, NPs, duplicatas, certidões, matrículas etc.), acompanhar a formalização das operações e monitorar a carteira para garantir o efetivo recebimento dos créditos.
  • Interagir com as áreas jurídica, comercial e de crédito e cobrança para desenvolver estratégias de mitigação de risco e soluções customizadas de crédito e cobrança, com foco na fidelização do cliente.
  • Acompanhar continuamente o lastro e os riscos vinculados às operações financeiras agrícolas, como CPRs e seguros, assegurando a integridade das garantias envolvidas.
  • Propor melhorias e desenvolver novas soluções de crédito e cobrança, contribuindo para o crescimento da companhia por meio da ampliação do portfólio e ações de cross-selling.
  • Atuar ativamente em comitês de crédito e cobrança, promovendo discussões técnicas e colaborativas com áreas internas e parceiros externos.



Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Ciências Econômicas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em análise de crédito e cobrança do agronegócio, especialmente operações de barter;
  • Experiência com execuções judiciais de garantias, especialmente arresto de penhor agrícola na safra;
  • Boa capacidade analítica, assertividade, planejamento e organização;
  • Boa comunicação (escrita e verbal) e habilidade em trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de visitas a clientes e reuniões periódicas presenciais.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview


The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.


Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.


Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.


Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.


Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.


Qualifications


Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.


Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Gerente de Vendas – Brasil
description:
Título do cargo: Gerente de Vendas – Brasil

Departamento: Vendas – APC, América Latina

Reporta a: Diretor de Vendas, América Latina


Propósito :

Impulsionar o crescimento comercial e técnico dos produtos da APC (plasma, hemácias e outros ingredientes do Grupo Lauridsen) nos mercados de suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura no Brasil, com foco na geração de demanda, no desenvolvimento de distribuidores, consultores e key accounts.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia de vendas

  • Liderar e executar o plano de vendas e negócios para a linha de produtos APC no Brasil, alinhado com as metas da APC em nível global.
  • Desenvolver e manter negócios com key accounts, incluindo cooperativas, premixeiras e fábricas de ração. Manter bom relacionamento com os clientes existentes e identificar um forte pipeline de oportunidades.
  • Selecionar / avaliar e nomear novos distribuidores para estados potenciais. Capacidade de gerenciar, motivar e treinar distribuidores.
  • Conhecimento técnico para promover ingredientes especiais e capacidade de demonstrar valor / retorno sobre investimento.
  • Conhecimento prático nas indústrias de Suínos, Aves e Aquicultura no mercado brasileiro. Liderar e impulsionar a ativação de novos negócios e manter bom relacionamento com tomadores de decisão-chave será uma vantagem adicional.
  • Formular estratégias comerciais para atingir as metas acordadas de vendas, margens e gestão de crédito para o Brasil.
  • Implementar o plano estratégico para expandir os negócios da APC no Brasil, incluindo gestão de canais.
  • Negociar preços e manter margens alinhadas aos objetivos regionais e globais.
  • Gestão de produto e planejamento estratégico.
  • Análise de dados para tomada de decisão (disponibilidade, demanda, capacidade).
  • Gerenciar estrategicamente os estoques das fábricas, garantindo eficiência e agilidade frente a diferentes cenários de demanda.
  • Demonstrar boa capacidade de escuta ativa, atendendo de forma eficaz clientes internos e externos.


Estratégia de marketing

  • Implementar o posicionamento adequado dos produtos e definir metas de desenvolvimento focadas para o Brasil.
  • Assegurar um bom entendimento das necessidades dos clientes, das condições de mercado e das atividades dos concorrentes para desenvolver estratégias de produto e de canais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com time regional e global para obter o suporte necessário.
  • Desenvolver um plano de marketing por meio de anúncios, feiras, seminários, eventos, entre outras atividades.


Requisitos:

Este cargo exige capacidades para aplicar habilidades de negócios e técnicas relacionadas às diferentes aplicações por espécie e ao uso dos produtos. Além disso, o ocupante da posição deve compreender as necessidades do mercado, identificar oportunidades e disseminar informações sobre os produtos, apoiando as áreas técnica e de marketing no desenvolvimento de planos/estratégias para o crescimento do negócio.


Condições de trabalho:

Esta posição exige que o ocupante viaje regularmente a trabalho. Além disso, o titular do cargo passa tempo nos seguintes ambientes: escritórios administrativos, conferências e escritórios de clientes. 

  • A vaga é destinada a cidadãos e residentes no Brasil.
  • Trabalho remoto com disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (40–60% do tempo).
  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo com bônus por desempenho.
  • Suporte regional e conexão com a estrutura técnica/comercial global.


Qualificações:

  • Formação acadêmica em Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária ou Agronomia, com conhecimento em Gestão de Negócios ou Marketing e paixão pela indústria de nutrição animal.
  • Cerca de 5 a 10 anos de experiência relevante em vendas e marketing na indústria B2B de nutrição animal.
  • Perfil comercial, postura prática e proativa, com boas habilidades de comunicação.
  • Sensibilidade multicultural e fluência em inglês.
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas em suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura.


Sobre a APC

A APC é líder mundial na produção e comercialização de proteínas sanguíneas derivadas de plasma e hemácias. Nossa história começou em 1981, quando os cientistas da APC descobriram o poderoso papel que as proteínas funcionais derivadas do plasma desempenham em ajudar a apoiar e manter a função imunológica em animais. O negócio pioneiro focado em estudos científicos rendeu mais de 600 artigos publicados em revistas científicas internacionais e mais de uma dúzia de patentes relacionadas à coleta e processamento das proteínas do sangue e do plasma. Hoje, a APC emprega mais de 500 pessoas e opera 17 fábricas em oito países em todo o mundo. A APC continua comprometida com a essência de sua missão de ajudar animais a atingir o melhor desempenho por meio do uso de proteínas funcionais inovadoras que impactam positivamente a saúde animal.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Infrastructure automation engineer
description:
Title: Infrastructure automation engineer

Location: Remote


The Lead, Infrastructure automation engineer role is part of the Cloud and Compute engineering organisation to drive an improved developer experience and automation first approach for adoption of public and hybrid cloud computing environment in a secured manner. This role will be passionate about developing cloud-agnostic infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management automation, ensuring associated security and compliance guardrails to meet application hosting requirements. The role is foran individual contributor who will develop Terraform, Chef and Python REST API based automation for automated provisioning, change, and decommission of VM, IaaS and PaaS database and Cloud resources in public cloud AWS, Azure, GCP and private cloud.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enforce CIS security standards for Windows and Linux operating systems using Chef or similar configuration management tools.
  • Deliver new cloud services to the business, while simplifying and improving service consumption and operational management
  • Leverage Python REST APIs to develop “Zero” touch provisioning, patching, change and decommissioning of VM, Kubernetes, PaaS database for lifecycle management of Hybrid Cloud resources.
  • Develop REST APIs in python using BDD methodology and implement public cloud security guardrails.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams for proof of technology in public cloud computing environment.
  • Build Hybrid Cloud infrastructure provisioning workflows leveraging continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines (CI/CD) running on Jenkins and or other CI CD tools.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams and drive resolution of sophisticated technical problems across infrastructure and application stack.
  • Design, engineer, implement Infrastructure As Code with API first and microservices based approach for public cloud service.

title: FPGA Engineer (Brazil) | Engenheiro(a) de FPGA (Brasil)
description:
The Opportunity

Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.


Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
  • Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.


Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
  • Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
  • Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
  • Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
  • Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
  • Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
  • Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
  • Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN;
  • Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
  • Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
  • Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
  • Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
  • Experience with hardware debug and tests;
  • Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
  • Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
  • Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
  • Fluency in English, both oral and written.


Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Remote work

______________________________________________________________

  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.
  • Grass Valley is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.

_______________________________________________________________


Oportunidade


Os Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Somos dedicados a redefinir a forma como as audiências vivenciam entretenimento e informação por meio de tecnologia inovadora.


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) FPGA altamente qualificado(a) e experiente, especializado(a) em Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast, para integrar nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) FPGA você será fundamental no design, desenvolvimento, teste e implementação de soluções baseadas em FPGA, especificamente voltadas para aplicações de Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.


Função

  • Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
  • Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;
  • Realizar simulação, testes, depuração e verificação detalhada dos designs FPGA para garantir funcionalidade perfeita e conformidade com padrões da indústria;
  • Manter e melhorar processos de build FPGA usando ferramentas CI/CD como Jenkins;
  • Estimar esforço de trabalho para estabelecer cronogramas de entrega de design;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências da indústria, padrões emergentes e tecnologias relacionadas a vídeo e áudio broadcast.


Quem é você

  • Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
  • Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
  • Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiência em depuração e solução de problemas em designs FPGA, incluindo uso de analisadores lógicos e outras ferramentas de debug;
  • Capacidade de criar documentação clara e concisa para designs FPGA, incluindo especificações de design;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas embarcados e sistemas operacionais em tempo real rodando em hardware desenvolvido internamente;
  • Experiência em design digital de alta velocidade, serialização de dados, streaming de mídia (ST2110) e protocolos de transmissão na indústria broadcast, especialmente vídeo HD-SDI;
  • Experiência com interfaces seriais de alta velocidade como PCIe, DDR, Ethernet e USB;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de comunicação como SPI, I2C, UART e CAN;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de design lógico digital e capacidade de criar circuitos digitais complexos;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e linguagens de programação C/C++ para programação FPGA e automação;
  • Compreensão de TCP/IP sob a perspectiva de programação de rede;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de código com sistemas de controle de versão como Git para rastrear releases e colaborar com a equipe por meio de branching e merging;
  • Fortes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação para colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais distribuídas, incluindo engenheiros de hardware, QA e gerentes de projeto;
  • Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de hardware, preferencialmente em função similar;
  • Experiência com debug e testes de hardware;
  • Sólido conhecimento em eletrônica analógica e digital, microcontroladores e FPGA;
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria, regulamentações e conformidade relacionadas ao design de hardware;
  • Proficiência em captura esquemática e supervisão de layout de PCB;
  • Fluência em inglês, oral e escrita.

title: Analista de Segurança Industrial (OT/ICS)
description:
Descrição da função:

Profissional responsável por garantir a segurança de ambientes OT, monitorando redes industriais, detectando anomalias e respondendo a incidentes. Atua na gestão de vulnerabilidades e acessos remotos, assegurando conformidade com base em normas técnicas. Contribui para a evolução das regras de detecção, governança e continuidade operacional.


Sobre a vaga:

  • Horário: 8:00h às 17:00h;
  • Modalidade: Remoto - disponibilidade para viagens.


Responsabilidades:

  • Monitorar continuamente redes e ativos OT para detecção de anomalias, ameaças e falhas que impactem processos produtivos;
  • Conduzir triagem, investigação e resposta a incidentes OT, coordenando ações com equipes de manutenção, engenharia e, quando necessário, com o SOC corporativo de IT;
  • Gerir vulnerabilidades em ambientes OT, priorizando riscos por criticidade e impacto operacional, recomendando e acompanhando ações corretivas ou compensatórias;
  • Gerir acessos remotos e ativos OT, garantindo governança de contas, revisão de privilégios, rastreabilidade e conformidade com políticas internas;
  • Implementar e manter conformidade com normas como IEC 62443, IEC 62264, NIST CSF/800-82, e NIS2, suportando auditorias e planos de ação;
  • Desenvolver engenharia de detecção, criando e ajustando regras de alarme e correlação, além de evoluir continuamente o conteúdo de monitoramento OT;
  • Integrar informações de PSIRT e CTI (ameaças e vulnerabilidades) ao processo de gestão de risco operacional;
  • Colaborar na criação e manutenção de planos de continuidade de negócio (BCP) e recuperação de operação em ambientes OT;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais sobre indicadores de segurança, risco e conformidade.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Arquitetura OT/ICS e modelo Purdue, segmentação de redes, DMZ OT, conduítes e zonas and IEC 62264/ISA-95;
  • Protocolos industriais: Modbus, Profinet, OPC-UA, DNP3, EtherNet/IP, entre outros;
  • Gestão de risco e conformidade: IEC 62443 (partes 2-1, 3-2, 3-3, 4-2), NIST CSF/800-82, e NIS2;
  • Vulnerability Management OT, priorizando riscos com base em impacto de processo e segurança funcional;
  • Resiliência OT e BCP, com foco em restauração de configurações, versões e firmware.


Idioma:

  • Inglês Avançado.


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance,  it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.


Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Founding Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Equity Only / Part-Time) – Build a Global Mental Health Platform (US-Based)
description:
To our friends in Brazil: We are specifically recruiting here because the React/Next.js talent is world-class, but often underutilized in local markets. We offer a bridge: Keep your day job, contribute 5-10 hours/week, and earn substantial equity in a US-based C-Corp.


This isn't a job. It's a mission. One billion people are struggling with their mental health. 700,000 preventable deaths each year. Only a fraction ever reach the right provider because borders, languages, and broken marketplaces stand in the way.


Unacceptable. We're fixing it.


Really Global is building the world's first truly global, provider-centric mental health marketplace—so anyone, anywhere, can find the right human in their language, at a price they can afford. We're already live at really.global in 200+ countries. The foundation exists. Now we build the infrastructure that scales.


Next: an AI-powered booking and translation layer with real-time audio translation, making quality care as accessible as ordering dinner. This is a system-level play. When we succeed, access to care becomes normal. Suffering becomes optional.


The Opportunity: Put Your Name on the Blueprint.

This is pure sweat equity for a true builder who's ready to trade the safety of a salary for substantial ownership in a $100M+ platform. You won't be building from scratch—you'll be accelerating what's already moving. Typical commitment: 5-10 hours/week, equity-only, alongside your primary role.


You won't be "feature support." You'll be foundational—your fingerprints on architecture, UX, velocity, and every product decision that helps someone find hope in their darkest moment.


We're backed by founders with a track record of scaling ventures to $130M+ in revenue. This will be the hardest and most meaningful work of your life.


Who You Are (and how you show up)


  • Mission-obsessed. The mental health gap bothers you enough to build the fix.
  • Owner's mindset. You grab the problem, simplify, and ship. Weekly.
  • Resourceful as hell. You bias to MVP, learn in production, and improve fast.
  • Resilient. You want the hard thing because the hard thing matters.
  • Clear, candid communicator. Crisp async writing; short demos; low-ego reviews.
  • Efficiency and Output Driven: Comfortable leaning hard on tools like Cursor, Claude, or Copilot to move 2x faster, or excited to learn and get there fast.


What You'll Build (and why it matters)

End-to-end product slices that remove friction between someone in crisis and someone who can help. Check really.global to see where we are. Here's what's next:


  • Add recurring calendar availability
  • Publish existing SEO content at scale and optimize the site
  • Roll out the Hotline
  • Complete Talk Now (instant sessions) and Find Matches (survey → ranked suggestions)
  • Add location-based navigation
  • Add site-wide translation and real-time audio translation
  • API/MCP integrations


Our stack: Next.js/React on the front; Python services; Postgres underneath; GitHub, AI-assisted workflows (Cursor/Copilot) to move faster without lowering the bar.


The Deal: Transparent Equity Partnership


  • Merit-based ownership. Contribution translates directly to equity from a dedicated 5% contributor pool. Your stake grows with every outcome you ship.
  • Points-for-outcomes system. We measure contribution in Story Points, a standard unit of complexity, not hours. This rewards your efficiency and impact.
  • All work is valued. You earn points not just for new features, but also for essential “glue work” like bug fixes, documentation, and incident response.
  • Real shipped value. Ownership accrues only when your work is reviewed by a peer (reviewer ≠ author), merged, and live in production. To protect our quality bar, we have a "regression clawback" for code that causes critical bugs.
  • Clear commitment & vesting. We use a 6-month active contribution cliff with a minimum monthly point threshold to ensure we're a great fit. After the cliff, your grant vests over a 3-year period.
  • Quarterly tranches. We calculate and update your accrued share from the dedicated pool each quarter; any unallocated equity rolls forward to the next. This ensures early contributions are fairly rewarded without burning through the pool.
  • High-impact bounties. Mission-critical milestones (e.g., Talk Now launch) carry outsized point rewards to align effort with key business goals.
  • Locked-in stake. When we close our first priced funding round, the program freezes and everyone's earned percentage becomes a fixed part of our cap table.
  • No hours theater. No politics. Value in production = ownership. All details are codified in a formal, transparent agreement covering vesting, IP, and security.


Why This Will Define Your Career


  • Build Your US Track Record: This is your entry point into the US startup ecosystem. You aren't outsourcing; you are a partner.
  • USD-Denominated Upside: You are trading time now for ownership in a dollar-based asset ($100M+ target valuation).
  • Direct Access: You work directly with US founders. No middle management. No "local office" politics.
  • Human Impact: Your code will literally save lives in 200+ countries, including your own.


Are You the One? If you felt a fire light up reading this—if the scale excites you more than it scares you—we want to hear from you.


This isn't for everyone. But for the right person, this is the opportunity of a lifetime.


To Apply: Send:

  • GitHub (or 1-2 PRs you're proud of) If you can include links to the actual PRs or issues (and a sentence or two of context), even better.
  • A short note: why this mission, and one gnarly problem you've shipped through


If you talk in hours, skip. If you talk in shipped outcomes, welcome.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


  • Projetar, construir e implantar modelos de analytics preditivos e prescritivos para apoiar a tomada de decisão baseada em dados em operações.

O que você precisa ter

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).

  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.

  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
  • Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
  • Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

  • Conduct performance evaluations, develop successors, and build future leaders;

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills;

  • English proficiency is a plus (reading and speaking).

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities:

- Configure switches and wireless access points.

- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.

- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.

- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.

- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.

- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary.

Qualifications:

- Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.

- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.

- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.

- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.

- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.

- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

About Design Manager

For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.

We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.



What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes


  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability


  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making


  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders


  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data


  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements


  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting


  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability


  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture


  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed


  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data


  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire




Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field


  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language


  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact


  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar


  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)


  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration


  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling


  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills


  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight




Nice to Have


  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments


  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains




Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation


  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility


  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company


  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment


  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs
